reviews.text: Why isn’t there an option to turn off autoplay?   After I finish watching a show on my DVR, it immediately goes to the next show or goes to on-demand and starts playing.    I should be able to control this feature.

reviews.text: Recent update added picture in picture.  Unfortunately, developers didn’t add a toggle to turn it off for those that find it annoying, even after closing Sling and going to another streaming service.

reviews.title: Weak
reviews.text: Constant streaming problems across all devices. Confusing interface. Guide is useless. Picture quality is bad. This should be half the price it is. Every other app is better.

reviews.title: This company has zero respect for privacy policies
reviews.text: My mom has been getting bombarded by scam and spam calls for ages. We didn’t know who leaked her number. Then I took over her Sling bill and to my surprise I started getting the same calls by Egyptian accent callers. It’s Sling who leaked the number though I opted out. This must be reported to the FTC and FCC. The app owners must stop this nonsense.

reviews.title: AppleTV remote not working well
reviews.text: This is not about the service it is about the app. If you are attempting to advance or rewind a program using the AppleTV remote, it rarely works. Even pausing the broadcast and moving the cursor then pressing play does not work. So fast forwarding thru commercial breaks often takes longer than just watching the damn commercials - which are repeated over and over and over again. Never had this problem with Fubo nor with any other streaming services such as Paramount+. Using your iPhone as the remote is marginally better but the frustration is starting to get really annoying.

reviews.title: Forced Sling Ads
reviews.text: I pay for Orange and Blue. Lately I’ve been forced to watch ads sponsored by Sling with no way to fast forward. These ads are on top of the ads from the content I’m watching. Stop doing this Sling.

reviews.title: Disappointing website experience
reviews.text:
I signed up for Sling specifically to watch an Ohio State game on Big Ten Network. I selected Select with Sports Extra, then chose a one-day pass—only to discover Sling had switched me to Orange with Sports Extra, which doesn’t include Big Ten Network. This was not made clear during checkout.

Once the pass was active, I couldn’t change my subscription and ultimately had to use another account just to get the package I originally wanted. The entire website and subscription-management process is incredibly clunky, slow, and confusing, especially when trying to upgrade or change a plan.

If short-term passes are Orange-only, Sling needs to make that very clear upfront. In the future, I would honestly consider paying more for another streaming service just to avoid the Sling experience altogether.

reviews.title: Freestream app sucks…redesign.
reviews.text:
I cannot sign into my paid account from this stupid Freestream app. thus I cannot watch my paid account programs on my IPad.
Never mind. I figured it out. Regular sign - in is at the bottom of the page. You don’t see it on an IPhone or IPad unless you scroll to bottom of the page. Not user friendly.

reviews.title: Beware the DVR
reviews.text: The app works fine, but I am now convinced after years of being a Sling customer that they sell commercials and force them into your DVR replay. When I advance the replay 30 seconds at a time, I can see that the show has resumed, but when I press play, I’m getting commercials that weren’t showing in the individual still shots as I advanced. Today I  missed an entire segment of a show because I could not get past the commercials and back to my show.

reviews.title: UNLIMITED DVR THAT DOESN’T RECORD? SERIOUSLY?
reviews.text: Extremely disappointed. I subscribed to Sling specifically for the Little League World Series and paid for Unlimited DVR because I wanted to save the games and watch them later. Today, the two games I wanted — Japan vs. Curaçao and Nevada vs. Ohio — DID NOT RECORD. I had Little League set to record all games, and tomorrow’s games are still showing as scheduled. I checked Recordings, Replays, and On Demand, and the games are nowhere. Meanwhile, other random programs recorded just fine. What exactly am I paying for if the ONE thing I subscribed for doesn’t record? Extremely frustrating and unacceptable. Sling needs to fix this.

reviews.title: App created by monkeys.
reviews.text:
I m certain that the app works for some. But I have never seen a streaming app that includes television programs with their episodes out of order and no way to sort them back into their proper order. Or have episodes missing from a season entirely. I don’t want to even get into the backwards somersaults I had to perform in order to create an account. 

Like many things these past ten to fifteen years, companies are hiring monkeys to program or manufacture their goods. This includes Apple as well. I’ll still never understand how apple can release things without ensuring that they work 100% as Jobs once required. The pop up keyboard GUI still completely covers what you type making impossible to see if it’s correct. Which is why there may be errors in this review. Apples new iPhones work like I remember windows XP in 2003.

reviews.title: False economy: Lineup changes a lot without warning, forgets to record, search function doesn't work
reviews.text: This is the worst TV service I've ever used. The lineup of channels changed constantly and without warning when I was a subscriber for seven months. Sling added and deleted several channels when I was subscribed, including MTV. It did not tell me whenever the lineup of channels changed, I always had to figure it out by going to the website since the App is useless and never updated. The service would "forget" to record programs on totally separate channels and record other programs in the same time slots. Customer service is all AI so there is never any response to problems. If you try to call the company you will get an AI chat or pretending to be human that will not help you. They overcharged me for the first month too and I had to fix it with my bank, luckily that was resolved to my favor. I would not recommend Sling to anyone, stay away. The app is very slow, search doesn't work, missing channels... you think you're saving money with Sling but it really is that draining because it just never, ever works. Ever.
